HomePage.description: A web or mobile-based application designed to help employees and management of Perumda Air Minum Surya Sembada Surabaya to find, understand, and comply with various internal company regulations, SOPs, and legal documents.

usefulFeature.title: Useful Features

subtitle.part2: to search for Company Documents and Regulations

usefulFeature.description: Responsible for measures to increase operational efficiency and ensure legal compliance within the company.

search.title: Quick Search & Filtering
search.description: Allows users to search for documents based on keywords, categories, or regulation numbers.

update.title: Automatic Regulation Updates
update.description: Provides the latest information on changes to Board of Directors Regulations, SOPs, or other internal documents.

compliance.title: Compliance Guide
compliance.description: Provides a summary and simple interpretation of complex rules to facilitate understanding and implementation.

notification.title: Alerts & Notifications
notification.description: Reminds users about relevant regulation updates or compliance deadlines related to their operations or interests.

bookmark.title: Bookmark & Notes Feature
bookmark.description: Users can save important regulations and add personal notes for future reference.

integration.title: Integration with Other Systems
integration.description: Supports integration with compliance management systems or ERP to enhance operational efficiency.
